title: Command
description: Guarded command and its read-back status (OQ-05 sections 3 and 8, OQ-04 section 12). People send the request form through the routes in v1.json with their own command_id; a repeat with the same body returns the same status. The API answers with the status form, and GET returns it again. record_evaluation_decision and freeze_candidates are internal: only the workflows service principal applies them, under an approved cohort policy, and no route accepts them. PENDING, APPLIED and REJECTED are server states. UNKNOWN is a client state: a timeout does not prove that no state changed.

CommandRequest.title: CommandRequest
CommandRequest.description: expected_revision is the compare-and-set revision of the target record. 0 means the record must not exist yet.

RegisterResearchProfile.title: RegisterResearchProfile
RegisterResearchProfile.description: Steward. Registers a new research profile revision for future work.

RegisterCohortPolicy.title: RegisterCohortPolicy
RegisterCohortPolicy.description: Steward. Registers and approves a new cohort policy revision before any trial uses it. Applying it records the Steward's approval Decision, which every policy-determined Decision under that revision names.

RegisterBudget.title: RegisterBudget
RegisterBudget.description: Steward. Registers a spending cap for a declared calendar period, across missions. Missions draw on it; new missions do not reset it. Service principals cannot create or enlarge it.

RegisterSeed.title: RegisterSeed
RegisterSeed.description: Researcher. Stores a seed draft that the Researcher authored, with its source-interpretation record: sources and every source-to-seed difference. draft is the strategy-artefact/1 for version 1 of a new strategy; its canonical digest is the draft digest. The draft is not yet a Strategy Version. A mission names it by that digest. The mission's first validate job validates it, and only a VALID result registers it as Strategy Version 1 in DRAFT. It then passes the same critique as any candidate.

SeedSource.title: SeedSource
SeedSource.description: A source reference: untrusted reference text, identified by the SHA-256 of its exact bytes.

CreateMission.title: CreateMission
CreateMission.description: Researcher. Creates a mission in status CREATED. The API assigns the mission ID and returns it in the status. run_mission_now starts it.

MissionSpec.title: MissionSpec
MissionSpec.description: One-instrument research mission. budget is the per-mission budget. The API rejects it when it exceeds the cohort policy maxima, breaks the equal-per-proposer rule or does not fit the remaining period cap that the profile names. seed_draft_digest names the seed draft that register_seed stored. The mission's first validate job validates it; only then is Strategy Version 1 registered. Each proposer configuration authors one controlled revision of the seed. The critic uses a separate profile and session.

AgentConfiguration.title: AgentConfiguration
AgentConfiguration.description: A proposer or critic configuration: executor profile plus behaviour-bundle hash, with the configured model's knowledge cutoff as the provider states it (OQ-03 section 2).

PublishedKnowledgeCutoff.title: PublishedKnowledgeCutoff
PublishedKnowledgeCutoff.description: The cutoff as the model provider states it (year and month, or a full date), the documentation it was read from and the date it was read.

UnpublishedKnowledgeCutoff.title: UnpublishedKnowledgeCutoff
UnpublishedKnowledgeCutoff.description: The provider documentation read states no cutoff for this model. It is never inferred. reason names what was read.

RunMissionNow.title: RunMissionNow
RunMissionNow.description: Researcher. Starts a CREATED mission: it becomes IN_PROGRESS and its bounded work starts. The evaluation plan is recorded at start, from the mission's frozen retrieved calendar, before any run. Policy-determined Decisions of the mission name the Researcher who applied this command.

CancelMission.title: CancelMission
CancelMission.description: Researcher. Withdraws the mission: it becomes WITHDRAWN, its open runs become CANCELLED and its open agent attempts are cancelled. Cancellation does not prove that a remote request stopped or cost nothing.

RecordEvaluationDecision.title: RecordEvaluationDecision
RecordEvaluationDecision.description: Internal: the workflows service principal only. Records the policy-determined DRAFT to EVALUATING Decision for the candidate in one trial slot (OQ-02 section 4). outcome follows from critique and the policy: APPROVED when the critique gave a valid result and no finding blocks this transition, REJECTED when one does, DEFERRED when the critique ended without a valid result. That happens at once after an outcome that is not retried, or when the attempt cap is exhausted after retried failures. In S1 no finding category blocks this transition. Applying an APPROVED Decision writes the candidate's development and validation runs, their reservations and outbox entries in one transaction. A DEFERRED candidate is not evaluated.

CompletedCritique.title: CompletedCritique
CompletedCritique.description: The critique attempt that completed. result is its strategy-critique.result/1 role output.

MissingCritique.title: MissingCritique
MissingCritique.description: The critique ended without a valid result. outcome says how the last attempt ended. refusal, denied_capability, authentication_failure and cancellation are not retried, so they end the critique at once. timeout, malformed_result and lease_expired are retried within the attempt cap; they end the critique when the cap is exhausted. lease_expired: the attempt's lease expired without a result, for example after a runner crash; it is not an execution outcome. attempts counts the attempts made.

PolicyAuthority.title: PolicyAuthority
PolicyAuthority.description: The authority behind a policy-determined Decision: the approved cohort policy revision, the Steward's approval Decision for it and the Researcher who started the mission.

FreezeCandidates.title: FreezeCandidates
FreezeCandidates.description: Internal: the workflows service principal only, under the approved policy. Freezes the candidate set once every slot is terminal (OQ-02 sections 3.3 and 4). slots lists every trial slot of the plan. Applying it writes the holdout runs of every EVALUATING slot, their reservations and outbox entries in one transaction. It also runs when the revision slots are terminal because the seed was not evaluated. If no slot is EVALUATING, it writes no run and the mission concludes NO_ELIGIBLE_CANDIDATE with the recorded reasons.

EvaluatedSlot.title: EvaluatedSlot
EvaluatedSlot.description: A slot whose candidate is EVALUATING. strategy_hash is the Strategy Version that its APPROVED Decision bound.

UnevaluatedSlot.title: UnevaluatedSlot
UnevaluatedSlot.description: A slot that gets no runs. DECISION_DEFERRED: the critique gave no valid result. NO_REGISTERED_VERSION: no draft passed validation for the slot: the seed draft failed validation, or no proposal passed within the revision budget. SEED_NOT_EVALUATED: a revision slot whose seed was not evaluated. No revision could run, because revision context needs the seed's development results.

CommandPending.title: CommandPending
CommandPending.description: Accepted and durable, not yet applied.

CommandApplied.title: CommandApplied
CommandApplied.description: Committed. record names the record and the revision the command produced.
